title: Senior iOS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful. 

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About the role

Ads Team:

Duolingo's Monetization pillar builds the systems that fund our mission: from subscription packaging and advertising to ML-powered personalization and beyond. As a Senior iOS Engineer on Ads, you'll work on a product engineering team responsible for growing and scaling Duolingo's ads business: bringing high-quality ads that delight learners, fit seamlessly into our product experience, and meaningfully contribute to Duolingo’s bottom line. The team will own the systems behind ad serving, mediation and demand, in-product ad formats and surfaces, and more. You'll work cross functionally with product, design, data science, machine learning, and ad operations.


🧠  You will...

  • Collaborate on software projects with product design and backend aspects
  • Develop, release, and maintain native iOS applications, primarily in Swift
  • Mentor and set technical direction for junior engineers across the company

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • A solid foundation in computer science with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Programming experience in Swift

  • Strong proficiency in Swift, with proven ability to build and maintain production-level applications

  • Experience designing clean and maintainable APIs

You will raise the creative bar, turn bold ideas into clear concepts, and guide execution from brief through launch—collaborating closely with Brand Marketing and Growth, International Marketing, Product, Design, BD, and global agency partners to build an iconic brand with measurable business impact. 🧠  You will...

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of creatives; set a high bar for craft, narrative, and taste while creating space for diverse voices and experimentation.

  • Partner with our Country Marketing team to lead and evolve our global agency roster; ensure scopes, standards, and handoffs produce A+ creative worldwide.
  • Oversee creative feedback and quality across all project stages; provide clear, timely decisions that keep momentum without sacrificing excellence.
  • Inspire the organization with industry trends, creative references, and new platforms; codify what’s “on‑brand” and how we measure brand success.

✅  You have...

  • Experience in brand/creative roles with significant time leading other creative leaders; proven success shipping integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets at a high bar.
  • Demonstrated ability to set vision, influence senior stakeholders, and connect creative decisions to strategy, KPIs, and ROI.
  • A track record of turning insights into iconic, culture‑driving ideas and guiding multi‑disciplinary teams from concept to launch.
  • Excellent communication and feedback skills; you simplify complex topics, make fast, sound calls, and bring others along.
  • Experience managing agencies and external partners across markets, with a reputation for raising quality and speed.
  • The ability to work from or relocate to New York City or London, UK

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Experience working with IP-led brands
  • Global brand experience, including creative leadership across multiple regions and cultures.
  • A portfolio demonstrating world‑class craft and storytelling— work that drives buzz and earned media attention instead of relying on paid channels for distribution.
  • Deep familiarity with social media and creator ecosystems, and how to translate cultural signals into breakthrough brand ideas.
  • Experience establishing clear creative operating mechanisms with marketing, product, and design partners.

We’re looking for a VP of Strategy and Corporate Development to join Duolingo’s Senior Leadership Team and drive strategy, planning and our growth via M&A.

Reporting to the Chief Business Officer, the VP of Strategy and Corporate Development will manage our Strategy and Business Operations and Corporate Development functions. Strategy and Business Operations at Duolingo is fast moving and iterative and represents the majority of this role. We’re seeking a leader who’s excited to work at a founder-led company, comfortable with ambiguity, and collaborates well with product and technical teams. Corporate Development at Duolingo supports key company priorities, with a focus on acqui-hires and targeted capability acquisitions rather than large transformational deals. We’ve used M&A to build functions, establish offices, and expand into new subjects. We’re excited to continue and expand our M&A activity.

This role is based in our Pittsburgh, PA or New York, NY office on a hybrid (4+1) work schedule. 

🧠  You will...

  • Partner with leaders across the company to develop strategies spanning our main Pillars: Growth, Monetization, Language Learning, and New Subjects (Math, Music and Chess).
  • Generate insights that directly influence product experiments and drive impact.
  • Run company-wide strategy and planning, driving alignment on strategic direction and resource allocation, including leading planning for Duolingo Board of Directors meetings.

title: Senior Learning Designer, Indian Languages
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

We are looking for a senior language educator and curriculum designer with linguistics training, deep expertise in Hindi, and strong knowledge of cultural and linguistic diversity in India and the whole South Asian region. You will help shape Duolingo’s learning experiences for Indian languages by using your pedagogical expertise, cultural insight, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and design partners to ship delightful, mobile-first learning that reflects the linguistic and cultural richness of Indian languages and advances Duolingo’s mission at scale. This role will help shape strategy and execution for new and existing Indian language courses. 

This role must be based in Pittsburgh, PA. No accommodations for remote or other locations will be provided.

🧠  You will...

  • Lead curriculum and learning design for one or more South Asian languages (starting with Hindi), balancing delight, cultural relevance, and measurable learning impact.
  • Leverage human-in-the-loop AI workflows and prompt engineering to generate and refine high-quality content efficiently while maintaining Duolingo’s quality bar.
  • Establish and maintain content quality systems (guidelines, rubrics, review workflows) to ensure linguistic accuracy, difficulty calibration, consistency, and brand voice across features and languages.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, and Scaling Operations to plan roadmaps, ship experiments, and build scalable content generation processes.
  • Contribute to strategy for teaching Hindi and other South Asian languages, informed by an understanding of the wider regional  linguistic and cultural context.
  • Help identify, recruit, onboard, and manage freelance educators, linguists, cultural consultants, and language reviewers representing relevant regions and communities.

✅  You have...

  • Hindi teaching curriculum expertise. You have deep proficiency in Hindi and substantial experience teaching it as an additional language. You understand its grammar, pronunciation, writing system, registers, variation, and common learner challenges. You have experience designing Hindi curricula.
  • India-centered cultural and regional expertise. Your cultural expertise is deepest in India, and you understand the broader South Asian sociolinguistic and sociopolitical context. You can navigate questions of language and identity, script, register, standardization, multilingualism, regional variation, and cross-border language communities with nuance.
  • Knowledge and curiosity about India’s broader linguistic landscape. You are familiar with Hindi’s place within the Indo-Aryan language family, including its relationship with Urdu and points of comparison with languages such as Punjabi and Bengali. You’re eager and able to deepen your knowledge of other Indo-Aryan and Dravidian languages quickly, and to collaborate effectively with language experts when working beyond your direct expertise.
  • Linguistics training and typological awareness. You have a background in linguistics, including language typology, and can apply it to unfamiliar languages – working effectively with language experts to identify learning challenges and design accurate, pedagogically sound courses.
  • Analytical thinking. You can evaluate linguistic questions systematically, distinguish errors from acceptable variation, and make clear decisions when conventions differ. You’re curious about AI-enabled, human-in-the-loop systems and excited to learn how to use them to support quality at scale.
  • Creativity and product sense. You can transform serious learning objectives into experiences that feel approachable, playful, culturally meaningful, and motivating.
  • Operational strength. You can lead complex projects, manage dependencies, maintain rigorous documentation, and improve processes without sacrificing quality.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration. You communicate complex linguistic and pedagogical concepts clearly to both specialists and non-specialists. You give and receive feedback well and build productive relationships across disciplines.
  • Relevant academic or equivalent professional preparation. You have a graduate degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Applied Linguistics, Language Education, Linguistics, Instructional Design, Learning Science, Indian or South Asian Languages, South Asian Studies, or a related field.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Working familiarity with Dravidian languages (particularly Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada) and understanding of key typological and pedagogical differences between Indo-Aryan and Dravidian language families.
  • Experience building human-in-the-loop generative-AI workflows for multilingual educational content.
  • Experience designing consumer-facing mobile or app-based language-learning products.

You will own the day-to-day operations of our Global Mobility program, manage immigration and mobility matters from assessment through completion, partner with candidates, Duos, and cross-functional teams, and oversee external providers. You’ll also improve policies, processes, and reporting so our programs stay compliant, competitive, and scalable as Duolingo grows globally.

🧠  You will...

  • Own the day-to-day operations of our Global Mobility program. Administer relocation policies, packages, eligibility, and exceptions consistently and efficiently. When something falls outside policy, bring a clear recommendation.
  • Manage employment-based immigration matters from initial assessment through filing, approval, and renewal, coordinating with employees, managers, Talent Acquisition, People Business Partners, Legal, and outside counsel.
  • Assess immigration and mobility needs for hiring, internal transfers, and changing business requirements, and advise partners on timelines, risks, costs, and available options.
  • Champion our mobility program with candidates. Partner with Talent Acquisition during the offer stage to walk candidates through their relocation package, answer their questions with confidence, and help them picture their move. This plays a real part in helping us close top talent.
  • Guide candidates and Duos through their immigration and relocation journey. Explain packages and processes, set clear expectations, coordinate key milestones, and communicate clearly at every stage, acting as a steady, empathetic point of contact through what is often a stressful transition.
  • Manage domestic and international relocation cases, including vendor coordination, service delivery, issue resolution, and post-move support.
  • Oversee immigration counsel and relocation and tax vendors, managing service delivery, SLAs/KPIs, costs, escalations, and performance. Use performance data and Duo feedback to hold partners accountable so every candidate and Duo gets timely, high-quality support.
  • Run business travel programs and onboarding-related logistics, making sure processes, communications, and vendor support run smoothly.
  • Monitor case progress, work authorization expirations, and policy requirements, escalate risks, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Maintain accurate case records, process documentation, and reporting while protecting confidential employee information.
  • Use data to make our programs better. Track case volume, cycle times, mobility activity, spend, vendor performance, exceptions, recurring issues, and Duo feedback, and turn it into insight that informs workforce planning and finds ways to improve.
  • Develop and improve immigration and mobility policies, workflows, playbooks, communications, self-service resources, and training that support consistent decisions and a positive Duo experience.
  • Stay current on the immigration and mobility landscape, including regulatory and tax developments, market practices, and relocation trends, and use what you learn to keep our program compliant and competitive.

✅  You have...

  • 5+ years of experience managing corporate immigration, global mobility, relocation, or related programs.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment-based immigration processes and experience coordinating cases with outside immigration counsel.
  • Experience managing domestic or international relocation cases and working with third-party mobility providers.
  • Ability to explain complex immigration and mobility requirements clearly to employees, candidates, managers, and People partners.
  • Strong case and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive matters with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and evolving regulatory requirements.
  • Experience using case data, service metrics, and employee feedback to identify risks and improve programs.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills and the ability to recommend practical solutions in complex or ambiguous situations.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Experience supporting immigration and mobility programs across multiple countries or regions.
  • Experience designing or scaling immigration, relocation, or global mobility policies and processes.
  • Experience managing immigration counsel, relocation providers, or other global mobility vendors.
  • Familiarity with immigration or global mobility case-management technology and HR information systems.
  • Experience supporting international transfers, permanent residency matters, or mobility-related tax and payroll coordination.

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About the role

As a Staff Security Engineer, you will shape and deliver Duolingo’s security strategy, safeguarding our learners, employees, systems, and services. You’ll identify the highest-impact security problems, lead complex initiatives from proposal through production, and build durable security capabilities across our applications and cloud infrastructure. Working across Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and IT, you’ll make practical risk decisions, establish secure-by-default patterns, and help teams ship safely at scale. This role is based in New York City. We know great candidates bring different combinations of experience. If you meet some or most of the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply!

:brain:  You will...

  • Set technical direction for security across Duolingo’s applications, cloud infrastructure, and engineering systems.
  • Lead complex, multi-team security initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, measurement, and ongoing ownership.
  • Design and build scalable security services, controls, and automation that prevent, detect, and remediate risks with minimal manual effort.
  • Partner with engineering teams to threat model systems, review architecture and code, prioritize risks, and deliver practical mitigations.
  • Strengthen security across the software-development lifecycle, including secrets management, dependency security, vulnerability management, and CI/CD controls.
  • Evaluate Duolingo’s security posture, use evidence to identify the highest-impact investments, and define measurable outcomes for security programs.
  • Lead technical response to significant security incidents and translate lessons learned into lasting improvements.
  • Establish reusable secure-by-default patterns for cloud and application infrastructure, including infrastructure as code.
  • Communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and company leaders.
  • Mentor engineers, scale security knowledge through documentation and guidance, and raise the technical bar across Engineering.

:check: You have...

  • A track record of leading large, complex security engineering initiatives across multiple teams from proposal through production.
  • Deep experience in at least two of the following areas: application security, product security, cloud security, infrastructure security, detection and response, or security automation.
  • Strong software-engineering skills in one or more programming or scripting languages and experience building reliable production systems or internal platforms.
  • Experience securing cloud environments and designing controls for identity, networking, data protection, secrets, logging, and workload security.
  • Experience applying threat modeling, architecture review, code review, and vulnerability analysis to real-world systems.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code and CI/CD to deliver repeatable, testable, and secure configurations.
  • Sound judgment in balancing security risk, engineering effort, product needs, and business priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders with different technical backgrounds.
  • The ability to work from or relocate to New York City.

:star: Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Experience building a security program or technical capability from an early stage and scaling it across an engineering organization.
  • Experience securing large, multi-account or multi-cloud environments, particularly AWS and GCP.
  • Experience creating security platforms or paved-road patterns adopted broadly by engineers.
  • Experience leading high-severity incident response and driving durable improvements afterward.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to security analysis, remediation, or control validation.
